title: DEEP BLUE | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Deep Blue - Luxury 30A Vacation Rental House Near Beach with Golf Cart, Water ViewsFavorite Features:- 4 Minute Walk to Beach
description_expanded: Deep Blue - Luxury 30A Vacation Rental House Near Beach with Golf Cart, Water Views Favorite Features: - 4 Minute Walk to Beach - Fireplace - Fire Pit - Water View - Golf Cart Included - 4 Bikes Included More about Deep Blue: Welcome to Deep Blue, a tranquil hideaway tucked into the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach. This thoughtfully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home is the perfect retreat for families, couples, or small groups seeking a peaceful, nature-inspired escape. Set against the backdrop of a serene lagoon, the property offers a front-row seat to Florida’s coastal wildlife—think graceful herons, curious egrets, ducks, and the soothing sounds of a waterfall. Inside, Deep Blue invites you to slow down and settle in. The cozy living area features a welcoming fireplace, ideal for cool coastal mornings or winding down after beach days. Natural light pours in through the windows, framing the peaceful views outside while keeping the space bright and airy. The fully equipped kitchen and open dining area create a comfortable setting for gathering, sharing meals, and making new memories. Step outside and you’ll find even more ways to unwind. The backyard is a perfect evening hangout, complete with a fire pit, cozy chairs, and garden lights that create a warm, inviting glow under the Gulf Coast sky for stargazing. A complimentary golf cart and bikes make exploring the area effortless, whether you're heading to local restaurants like Stinky’s Fish Camp or Shunk Gulley, cruising to nearby boutiques at Gulf Place, or making the short ride to the sugar-white sandy beaches. Deep Blue offers the best of both worlds: the privacy and quiet of a tucked-away sanctuary, with convenient access to all the best parts of 30A. Whether you’re watching wildlife with a morning coffee, soaking up the sun by day, or toasting s’mores at night, every moment here feels like a breath of fresh air. Your coastal escape awaits. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Queen Daybed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 3:  King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.
